
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/20520195" title="发布于 2026-06-14 13:25">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">27. Agent 需要拦截模型调用？用 Middleware 给它加个“拦截器“！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>你有没有遇到过这种情况：Agent 跑得好好的，你想加个日志看看它到底在干嘛，或者想加个安全检查防止它搞出危险操作，结果发现不知道往哪儿插？</p>
<p>Middleware 就是来解决这个问题的。说白了，它就是一个"拦截器"，让你在模型调用前后插入你自己的逻辑。听起来是不是挺简单的？别急，咱们直接上手写代码，你一看就明白了。</p>
<p>动画视频在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1NwJc68Ehr/" rel="noopener nofollow">《27. Agent 需要拦截模型调用？用 Middleware 给它加个"拦截器"！》</a>。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202606/1919157-20260614132327737-1360610115.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;第一个 Middleware：日志记录</p>
<p>咱们先从一个最简单的需求开始——记录日志。我想知道每次调用<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="模型" data-pretit="模型">模型的时候，当前有多少条消息，模型又回了什么。</span></p>
<p>怎么做呢？很简单，写一个类，继承 AgentMiddleware，然后实现两个方法就行。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.agents.middleware <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentMiddleware
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.agents <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentState
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langgraph.runtime <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Runtime
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LoggingMiddleware(AgentMiddleware):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> before_model(self, state: AgentState, runtime: Runtime) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[日志] 即将调用模型，当前消息数: {len(state['messages'])}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> after_model(self, state: AgentState, runtime: Runtime) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
        last_msg </span>= state[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>][-1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[日志] 模型已响应: {last_msg.content[:50]}...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>你注意看啊，这里有两个方法。before_model 就是在模型调用之前执行的，我打印一下当前消息的数量。after_model 是模型响应之后执行的，我取最后一条消息，截取前 50 个字符看看模型回了啥。</p>
<p>关键点来了——你注意这两个方法的返回类型，都是 None。为啥？因为这个 Middleware 只是记录日志，它不需要干预流程，所以直接返回 None，就是在告诉框架："我完事了，你继续往下走就行。"</p>
<p>好，日志中间件搞定了。是不是特别简单？接下来咱们上点强度——写一个安全检查中间件。</p>
<p>第二个 Middleware：安全检查</p>
<p>这个中间件的作用是啥呢？拦截危险操作。比如用户说"删除所有文件"，你肯定不想让 Agent 傻乎乎地去执行吧？</p>
<p>同样继承 AgentMiddleware，重点在 before_model 里做文章。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.messages <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AIMessage
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SafetyMiddleware(AgentMiddleware):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> before_model(self, state: AgentState, runtime: Runtime) -&gt; dict |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
        last_msg </span>= state[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>][-1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].content
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">删除</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> last_msg <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">危险</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> last_msg:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">jump_to</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">end</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [AIMessage(content=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">检测到危险操作，已终止</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
            }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> None</pre>
</div>
<p>这里有个关键区别，你一定要注意到——返回类型变了，变成了 dict | None，而不是单纯的 None。</p>
<p>为什么？因为这个 Middleware 有可能需要干预流程。</p>
<p>逻辑是这样的：拿到最后一条消息的内容，检查一下里面有没有"删除"或者"危险"这样的关键词。如果命中了，就返回一个字典，jump_to 设为 "end"，意思是跳过模型调用直接结束。同时塞一条 AIMessage 告诉用户操作被终止了。这个返回值就是在告诉框架："别调用模型了，直接结束，并且把这条消息加进去。"</p>
<p>如果没有问题呢？就返回 None，意思是"我没意见，流程正常继续"。</p>
<p>你看，这就是 Middleware 的精髓——你可以选择不管，也可以选择直接接管整个流程。</p>
<p>完整实战代码</p>
<p>好，两个 Middleware 都写好了，接下来咱们把它们组装起来，看看实际效果。</p>
<p>先把需要的依赖都导入进来，然后配置模型、定义工具。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> before_model(self, state: AgentState, runtime: Runtime) -&gt; dict |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None:
        last_msg </span>= state[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>][-1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].content
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">删除</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> last_msg <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">or</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">危险</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> last_msg:

config </span>= {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configurable</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">thread_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">session-1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}}
 
store.put((</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user-1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>), <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">profile</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
          {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">developer</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">skills</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">typescript</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">java</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]})
profile </span>= store.get((<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user-1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>), <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">profile</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用户资料：{profile.value}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
 
queries </span>= [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算 2024*12+500，然后把结果保存到 result.txt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
           </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">读取 result.txt的内容</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
           </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">列出当前目录文件</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
           </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">刚才计算的结果是多少？</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
           </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">删除所有文件</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
           ]
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> q <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> queries:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n问：{q}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    response </span>= agent.invoke({<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: q}]}, config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(response)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n答：{response['messages'][-1].content}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
 
checkpoint_conn.close()
store_conn.close()</span></pre>
</div>
<p>代码比较长，但核心逻辑其实就三块：模型配置、Middleware 定义、Agent 创建。</p>
<p>你重点看 create_agent 这一行——注意 middleware 这个参数，咱们把 LoggingMiddleware 和 SafetyMiddleware 两个实例一起传进去了。就这么一行，Agent 就同时具备了日志记录和安全拦截的能力。</p>
<p>然后下面准备了一些测试问题，挨个发给 Agent 执行。你注意最后一个问题——"删除所有文件"，这就是用来测试安全检查中间件的。</p>
<p>运行效果</p>
<p>跑起来之后你会看到什么呢？</p>
<p>首先，每次模型调用前后，控制台都会打印日志信息，告诉你当前消息数和模型响应内容，这就是 LoggingMiddleware 在干活。</p>
<p>然后，当前面几个正常问题执行的时候，一切顺利。但是到了最后一个问题"删除所有文件"的时候，Agent 直接返回"检测到危险操作，已终止"——根本不会去调用模型。这就是 SafetyMiddleware 在拦截。</p>
<p>总结</p>
<p>好了，今天的内容就到这里，咱们快速回顾一下。</p>
<p>Middleware 说白了就是 Agent 的"拦截器"，它给你提供了两个钩子：before_model 和 after_model。你可以在模型调用前注入上下文、检查权限，也可以在模型响应后记录日志、审计操作。</p>
<p>最关键的是，你可以通过返回值来控制流程——返回 None 就是"我没意见，继续走"，返回一个 dict 就可以直接改变流程走向，比如跳过模型调用。</p>
<p>这个机制非常灵活，你可以用它做很多事情：限流、鉴权、日志、审计、上下文注入……基本上你能想到的横切关注点，都可以用 Middleware 来优雅地实现。</p>
<p>如果觉得有用的话，记得点赞关注，咱们下期再见！</p>
